brief:
UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan held discussions on bilateral relations during a visit by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to the Gulf country on Sunday, the Emirati state news agency WAM reported. The meeting marked direct engagement between the two leaders on matters affecting their countries' relationship.

Details of specific topics covered in the talks were not disclosed by the Emirati state news agency.
dek: CAIRO, Sept 28 (Reuters) - UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan discussed bilateral relations during a visit on Sunday by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to the Gulf country, the Emirati state news agency WAM reported on Monday.
title: UAE president meets Netanyahu to discuss bilateral ties
